entries.definition: Right-living. God is Right-Living by definition — His ways and works are the measure of right. For those under His authority, right-living is the doing of His commandments: the law kept, worn as the garment of righteous acts. Righteousness is given and reckoned by grace, not earned as a debt, but the gift never renames wrong-living right.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: primarily right standing before God — Christ's imputed righteousness received by faith apart from works — with right-living as its subsequent fruit and evidence.
entries.citations: (Deut 32:4; 6:25; Ps 119:172; 145:17; Rom 4:4-8; Phil 3:9; 1 John 3:7) · see Garments & Armor, ch. 43
